description: Source code for a parser class 'ParserProtoLog' that handles decoding and processing of ProtoLog trace files, including version checks, timestamp handling, and message processing.

classes.name: ParserProtoLog
classes.description: A parser class for handling ProtoLog trace files, extending AbstractParser, with methods for decoding, timestamp processing, and message handling.

classes.name: FormatStringMismatchError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling format string mismatches during log message processing.

methods.name: getTraceType
methods.description: Returns the trace type, specifically TraceType.PROTO_LOG.

methods.name: getMagicNumber
methods.description: Returns the magic number array identifying ProtoLog files.

methods.name: decodeTrace
methods.description: Decodes a buffer into trace log entries, verifying version compatibility and sorting log entries by elapsed realtime nanoseconds.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Generates a Timestamp object based on the entry proto and requested timestamp type, adjusting for real-time offset if needed.

methods.name: processDecodedEntry
methods.description: Processes a decoded log entry, returning either a formatted or unformatted log message based on message hash lookup.
